decisions.reason: Creating a specific MeetAlfred campaign and configuring a copied Zap does not change the separate rules for recirculating silent leads into follow-up campaigns.
The source describes campaign and Zap setup but does not revise the policies against deleting existing campaigns or using existing leads for testing.
The new campaign workflow neither disconnects the MeetAlfred integration nor changes the requirement to keep it connected.
Creating a campaign inside the already configured MeetAlfred platform does not change the platform setup or subscription-plan state.
Configuring a copied Zap for a new campaign is consistent with the existing Zapier-based synchronization but does not change its direction, object, platforms, or automatic-import requirement.
The source does not discuss or alter integration of the campaign email account with MeetAlfred and HubSpot.
Copying and configuring a Zap for one campaign does not change the Zapier account setup, subscription plan, or add-on selection.
The new campaign and Zap setup does not alter how MeetAlfred reply activity is represented in HubSpot Lead Status.
The source does not change the campaign-domain mailbox, its provider, or its authentication behavior.
Campaign creation and Zap configuration do not resolve or modify how existing CRM records are indicated to users.
The source does not alter which communication-history channels are visible in HubSpot lead records.
The source provides no decision about importing LinkedIn profile URLs or excluding Sales Navigator URLs.
